_comment: Cycle-charge stance demo (seed 12345): box-select the player's two cavalry regiments (right of the line, ~x 1027 and 1356, y 300), press J to arm the Cycle charge stance, then right-click the enemy Infantry regiment at (291,880). The horse charges in, lands its momentum hit, then peels back to a standoff and charges AGAIN -- the caracole loop -- instead of grinding in melee once the charge bonus is spent. The HUD flashes 'Cycle charge' when J is pressed and the order cursor turns violet.

overlap.reason: uid8 (team 1's own cavalry by scenario order: spearmen, infantry, archers, cavalry, cavalry) is a deep block (505.8wu spread, depth ratio 2.81) under a continuous AI ATTACK order whose target_enemy_uid re-selects mid-clip (uid3 through tick 540, uid4 from tick 600, uid2 from tick 1200); it never reaches melee (state MOVING, engaged false, through tick 1300) and each retarget re-rotates the block before it has re-squared, which compresses its own files at the clip's final sample: measured at the catalog cadence on this tree, nnd_min 4.49wu at tick 1300 against the 5.0wu floor (stale_exempt false). uid3 and uid7 used to share this entry; both now pass unexempted at the same cadence (uid3 worst 5.86wu, uid7 worst 2.52wu, both against the 2.25wu foot floor) and were dropped.

shape_residual.reason: Charging cavalry block deforms during cycle-charge impact, peel-back, and subsequent regrouping. Uid8 (team 1's own cavalry by scenario order: spearmen, infantry, archers, cavalry, cavalry) is the deep block from the overlap exemption above (505.8wu spread, depth ratio 2.81) and never reaches melee over the whole clip (state stays MOVING, engaged false, through tick 1300): it's under a continuous AI ATTACK order whose target_enemy_uid re-selects mid-run (uid3 through tick 540, uid4 from tick 600, uid2 from tick 1200), and each retarget demands a sharp reorientation the deep block can't finish before the next one lands -- the slots-to-bodies fit angle swings from 4deg at tick 540 to 92deg at tick 600 (the 3->4 retarget), unwinds only to 30-46deg by tick 960-1140, then reverses again to -79deg at the 4->2 retarget (tick 1200). The shape-fit residual tracks that unfinished turn: 20.3wu at the first retarget (tick 600), climbing to worst=118.2wu at tick 900-960 (spacing 40wu x SHAPE_RMS_FRAC floor 30.0), and still 88.8wu at the clip's last sampled tick (1300) because the block is never left on one heading long enough to complete the fit before the AI moves the target again. Same AI chase-trajectory divergence already documented for uid7/uid8's overlap above, now visible as sustained shape scramble instead of compression; measured at the catalog cadence on this tree. This is read as the honest physics of a continuously-retargeting deep block with no reform order, not a formation-code defect -- whether the AI's retarget hysteresis should hold a heading longer before flipping is an open design question, tracked separately. uid3 is the player's charging cavalry itself, the block the first sentence describes: its residual is the impact, peel-back, and regroup deformation of the charge the clip is built around.

path_crossing.reason: Charging cavalry paths cross during the cycle-charge breakthrough, disengagement wheel, and realignment.
